policies.title: FERC Order 2023 / 2023-A
policies.date_note: Original rule effective date; provider implementation and subsequent orders require separate review.
policies.fact: Order 2023 reforms generator interconnection through cluster studies, readiness requirements and study deadlines. Order 2023-A revises or clarifies parts of the rule.
policies.impact: Potential delivery timing and development deposit exposure. No quantified delay or cost is inferred.
policies.action: Obtain the applicable transmission-provider tariff, queue stage and latest compliance order before assessing COD.
policies.scope_note: Candidate screen for non-operating generation outside ERCOT. Queue stage and tariff jurisdiction are unverified; this is not a data-center load interconnection rule.
policies.verification: Named source reviewed; subsequent amendments, litigation and implementation not exhaustively checked.

policies.title: Virginia renewable and zero-carbon requirements
policies.date_note: Codified section includes provision-specific and conditional effective dates; no single date assigned.
policies.fact: Virginia law sets renewable portfolio requirements for Phase I and Phase II utilities, with separate schedules and resource provisions.
policies.impact: Potential changes in utility procurement and eligible REC supply. A utility obligation is not automatically a corporate procurement obligation.
policies.action: Identify serving utility, customer arrangement, applicable statutory version and REC eligibility before comparing procurement options.
policies.scope_note: Geographic context only. Utility class, service territory and contract allocation must be confirmed.
policies.verification: Named source reviewed; subsequent amendments, litigation and implementation not exhaustively checked.

policies.title: Texas SB 6 large-load framework
policies.date_note: Enrolled text contains conditional commencement language. Signed-law history and current implementing rules still need verification.
policies.fact: The enrolled text directs large-load interconnection standards in ERCOT, including a 75 MW demand threshold unless the commission determines a lower threshold is necessary.
policies.impact: Potential service-readiness and reliability diligence for a qualifying load. Supply-asset MW cannot establish customer load or statutory applicability.
policies.action: Confirm campus electrical demand, utility service request, signed-law status and current PUCT / ERCOT implementation.
policies.scope_note: Texas supply assets are context only. No site-level electrical-load records exist in this portfolio, so no qualifying large load is inferred.
policies.verification: Named source reviewed; subsequent amendments, litigation and implementation not exhaustively checked.

policies.title: California SB 100 clean electricity policy
policies.date_note: 2045 is a policy target, not an effective date. Commencement of individual provisions is not verified here.
policies.fact: SB 100 establishes a policy for renewable and zero-carbon resources to supply all retail electricity sales by 2045.
policies.impact: Potential long-term procurement and resource-mix implications. This does not establish hourly matching or an individual facility compliance duty.
policies.action: Identify load-serving entity, service arrangement and resource eligibility before assessing portfolio procurement implications.
policies.scope_note: Geographic context only. Retail supplier obligations and procurement eligibility need separate confirmation.
policies.verification: Named source reviewed; subsequent amendments, litigation and implementation not exhaustively checked.
